title: Claude Prompts MCP Configuration
description: Configuration for the Claude Prompts MCP server

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation

name.description: Server name reported to MCP clients

transport.description: Transport protocol: 'stdio' for CLI tools (Claude Code), 'streamable-http' for web clients, 'both' for either

port.description: Port for SSE transport (ignored for stdio)

directory.description: Directory containing prompt definitions (relative to server root)

registerWithMcp.description: Register prompts as MCP resources for client discovery

identity.description: Identity and client-profile resolution for scope isolation and delegation routing

allowPerRequestOverride.description: Allow request claims to override launch defaults based on transport policy

launchDefaults.description: Launch-time defaults used when request identity/profile metadata is missing

clientFamily.description: Authoritative launch-level client family for delegation routing

frameworks.description: Frameworks (CAGEERF, ReACT, etc.) that guide LLM behavior. Controls three injection types: system-prompt (framework phases), gate-guidance (quality criteria), and style-guidance (response formatting).

dynamicToolDescriptions.description: Adapt MCP tool descriptions based on active framework

defaultFramework.description: Framework a scope falls back to when it has no persisted state row. Set per project to pin a repo to one framework (e.g. 'RADIANT' for design work). A runtime framework switch overrides this for that scope and persists.

systemPromptFrequency.description: Inject framework guidance every N chain steps. Higher values reduce token usage at the cost of less frequent framework reinforcement.

systemPromptTarget.description: Where to inject framework guidance: 'steps' (normal execution), 'gates' (gate reviews), or 'both'

gateGuidanceFrequency.description: Inject gate criteria every N chain steps. 0 = first step only (default). Gate review steps always receive guidance regardless of this setting.

gateGuidanceTarget.description: Where to inject gate criteria: 'steps' (normal execution), 'gates' (gate reviews), or 'both'

styleGuidance.description: Include response formatting guidance in prompts

styleGuidanceFrequency.description: Inject style guidance every N chain steps. 0 = first step only (default). Set to 1 for every step.

styleGuidanceTarget.description: Where to inject style guidance: 'steps' (normal execution), 'gates' (gate reviews), or 'both'

gates.description: Quality gates for validating LLM outputs

methodologyGates.description: Deprecated pre-rename spelling of frameworkGates; still read, folded forward by ConfigManager

evaluation.description: Judge evaluation defaults. Gates with evaluation.mode 'judge' use context-isolated review via delegation.

defaultMode.description: Default evaluation mode for all gates: 'self' (same-context review) or 'judge' (context-isolated delegation)

defaultModel.description: Default model hint for judge sub-agents (e.g., 'haiku' for cheap evaluation)

strict.description: Default strict mode: use failure-first framing for judge evaluation

verification.description: Ralph Loops: autonomous verification via shell commands

inContextAttempts.description: Fix attempts within current context before spawning isolation. Set to 0 for immediate isolation.

isolation.description: Context isolation spawns a fresh Claude CLI to fix issues

enabled.description: Enable spawning isolated Claude instances after in-context attempts fail

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each isolation spawn

permissionMode.description: How spawned instance handles permission requests

maxVersions.description: Maximum versions to retain per prompt

phaseGuards.description: Phase guards: deterministic structural validation of LLM output against framework phase definitions (zero LLM cost)

mode.description: Enforcement mode: 'enforce' blocks advancement until structural requirements pass, 'warn' logs advisory warnings, 'off' disables phase guards

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before phase guard review expires (enforce mode only)

hooks.description: Claude Code hook behavior (affects prompt-suggest.py output)

expandedOutput.description: Show detailed multi-line output instead of compact single-line. Useful for debugging or verbose mode.

telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry observability: tracing, metrics, and attribute policy. Separate from resources.observability (MCP resource toggles).

enabled.description: Master switch for the telemetry subsystem. When false, no OTel SDK is initialized.

samplingRate.description: Head sampling rate for traces (0.0–1.0). 1.0 = sample everything, 0.0 = sample nothing.

attributePolicy.description: Controls which attributes are included in trace spans and events for data safety.

businessContext.description: Include safe business-context attributes (cpm.prompt.id, cpm.execution.mode, etc.)

rawCommands.description: Include raw command text in traces. WARNING: may contain sensitive data.

rawResponses.description: Include raw user responses in traces. WARNING: may contain sensitive data.

allowlist.description: Custom attribute names to explicitly include in traces

resources.description: MCP resources configuration. Master switch must be enabled for any resources to register.

registerWithMcp.description: Master switch: register resources with MCP protocol (default: false for token efficiency)

logs.description: Logs resource for debugging and observability

maxEntries.description: Maximum log entries to retain in memory

defaultLevel.description: Minimum level to buffer (entries below this level are not stored)

advanced.description: Internal settings (most users won't need to change)
